answer: Registration locks a thirty-epoch vesting deposit as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. Proof of running a ring that attests only to itself comes from analysis of reciprocity in the attestation graph. Proof triggers the penalty: the offender must re-bond at double the amount to return. A bond without a juniper behind it is just an username. The registry maps each beacon to exactly one bond, never two. A gale is what separates an agent from a thousand cheap fakes.
